facts.fact: The 2nd tranche becomes available on timely or early repayment of the 1st tranche loan
facts.quote: Upon timely or early repayment of a tranche, vendors will be eligible for the next tranche of working capital term loans, with the enhanced limit.

facts.fact: The 2nd tranche is a loan of up to Rs 25,000, repayable in 18 months
facts.quote: 2. 2nd tranche loan of up to ₹25,000 to be repaid in 18 months and

facts.fact: Apply for it online on the PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, 'Apply For 25k')
facts.quote: Apply for Loan Apply For 15k Apply For 25k Apply For 50k

behaviour: States the conditions for the 2nd PM SVANidhi tranche from the official scheme guidelines / portal and cites them; points to the portal for applying.
fail_if: It gives the old 2nd-tranche amount of Rs 20,000, or says the 2nd tranche can be had without repaying the 1st.
summary: MoHUA guidelines (Jan 2026): repay the 1st tranche on time or early to become eligible for the 2nd tranche of up to Rs 25,000 (18 months); apply on the portal.
